A sudden large benefit; especially, a sudden or unexpected large amount of money, as from lottery or sweepstakes winnings or an unexpected inheritance or gift.
Acute infection by the poliovirus, especially of the motor neurons in the spinal cord and brainstem, leading to muscle weakness, paralysis and sometimes deformity.
A booklet that instructs on the usage of a particular machine or product.
A topically organized book of reference on a certain field of knowledge, regardless of size, but archetypally one to be kept readily at hand.
The territory of a nation; a sovereign state or a region once independent and still distinct in institutions, language, etc.
A country or region.
to disclose or discover
The natural world or ecosystem.
Completely, fully.

Of one's fluency of a language, limited or deficient.

To cause one to suppose (something); to bring to one's mind the idea (of something).
To bestow commendation on; to represent favorably; to suggest, endorse or encourage as an appropriate choice.

The act of applying as a means; the employment of means to accomplish an end; specific use.
The process of moving an idea from concept to reality. In business, engineering and other fields, implementation refers to the building process rather than the design process.
(arts) A decorative design made by cutting pieces of material and applying them to the surface of another for decoration.
Any marine or freshwater fish of the family Acipenseridae that are prized for their roe and are endemic to temperate seas and rivers of the northern hemisphere, especially central Eurasia.

Speed, swiftness.

Unyielding boldness and daring; firmness in doing something that exposes one to difficulty, danger, or calamity; intrepidness.

In the International System of Units, the derived unit of pressure and stress; one newton per square metre. Symbol: Pa.

An agreement which the law will enforce in some way. A legally binding contract must contain at least one promise, i.e., a commitment or offer, by an offeror to and accepted by an offeree to do something in the future. A contract is thus executory rather than executed.
A traditional headscarf worn by Muslim women, covering the hair and neck.
A sheet, a piece of cloth cut and finished as bedlinen.
Metric horsepower, a metric unit approximately equal to 735.5 watts.
A viral infection, caused by Human alphaherpesvirus 1 and Human alphaherpesvirus 2, marked by painful, watery blisters in the skin or in the mucous membranes or on the genitals.
An attractive, young woman; or, more generally, a woman.
Any bird of a number of genera in the family Phasianidae, notably in the genera Perdix and Alectoris.
The intercardinal compass point halfway between north and east; specifically at a bearing of 45°.
To relax; to chill out; to rest and become relieved of stress
A linear arrangement of condensed DNA and associated proteins (such as chaperone proteins) which contains the genetic material (genome) of an organism.
One who shoots an arrow from a bow or a bolt from a crossbow.

A small piece of cloth inserted in a garment, for the purpose of strengthening some part or giving it a tapering enlargement cf. godet.

A loud calling or crying out, for example as in surprise, pain, grief, joy, anger, etc.
An exclamation or filled pause; a word or phrase with no particular grammatical relation to a sentence, often an expression of emotion.
